environment: Installed headless Chromium / SwiftShader, simulated safe insets and touch; no physical hardware, screen reader, Safari/Firefox or WeChat
method: Real browser input for title/settings, driving, pause/resume and camp. To bound software-render time, after actual initial driving the test uses the existing place() hook for a 35m near-station fixture, waits for terrain and takes the normal arrival trigger using physics ticks. On phone portrait the actual rotation message is captured then hidden only in the test page to inspect underlying layout. No vendor edits or save-state injection.

drawsSomething.note: colours are counted in steps of sixteen; dominant is the share of the commonest colour

keepsRunning.note: software rendering: frames must keep advancing while idle and during input

caveat: This engine pin does not send native World3DOverlay control receipts to verify --screens. Independent play checks use real native semantic control bounds and verify their projected CSS rectangles, not invented receipt data.
finalVerificationNote: Plain eight and standalone verify are the repeat after the inline favicon metadata fix. The 59-checkpoint route, 8 resizes, and their screenshot sheets predate only that metadata change; all runtime/layout code is identical.
